scripts.build: bun run build-pre && bun run --workspaces --if-present build && bun run build-assets
scripts.build-misskey-js-with-types: bun run build-pre && bun run --filter i18n --filter misskey-reversi --filter backend build && bun run --filter backend generate-api-json --no-build && cp packages/backend/built/api.json packages/misskey-js/generator/api.json && bun run --filter misskey-js update-autogen-code && bun run --filter misskey-js build && bun run --filter misskey-js api
scripts.start: cd packages/backend && bun run compile-config && bun ./built/entry.js
scripts.start:inspect: cd packages/backend && bun run compile-config && bun --inspect ./built/entry.js
scripts.start:test: cp ./.github/misskey/test.yml ./.config/test.yml && cd packages/backend && NODE_ENV=test bun run compile-config && NODE_ENV=test bun ./built/entry.js
scripts.migrateandstart: bun run migrate && bun run start
scripts.lint: bun run --sequential --no-exit-on-error --workspaces --if-present lint && bun run check-dts
scripts.e2e: bun run start-server-and-test start:test http://localhost:61812 "bun run --filter frontend test:e2e"
scripts.e2e-dev-container: cp ./.config/playwright-devcontainer.yml ./.config/test.yml && bun run start-server-and-test start:test http://localhost:61812 "bun run --filter frontend test:e2e"
